newsitem.title: USA: Quaker Fabric says fund selling shares.
newsitem.headline: Quaker Fabric says fund selling shares.

text.p: Quaker Fabric Corp said Wednesday it planned to file for a secondary offering of 3,100,000 shares, primarily from a fund controlled by Morgan Lewis Githens and Ahn, a New York based investment firm, which purchased the shares nearly four years ago.
Upon completion of the contemplated offering, Quaker management, in the aggregate, will become the company's largest single shareholder, the company said.

The company also said it planned to file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission in the near future covering a primary offering of 300,000 shares to raise funds to accelerate the expansion of the company's chenille yarn manufacturing capacity.
